topography.project_purpose: Hybra is a decentralized exchange (DEX) protocol on HyperEVM that facilitates token swaps, liquidity provision, and yield farming. It employs a ve(3,3) tokenomics model with gauges, bribes, and voting to incentivize liquidity and governance.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Hybra V4 family relies on shared infrastructure contracts such as GaugeFactory, BribeFactoryV3, VoterV3, and MinterUpgradeable to manage liquidity incentives, governance voting, and token emissions across the protocol.
